monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_tbd_theme_pulse oe_tbd_byz_pulse } }
# Each country: only marches (and themes that still carry a pressure) pass the trigger; quarterly recalc or immediate dirty-flag refresh.
oe_tbd_theme_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        country_exists = c:BYZ
        OR = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 2 has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure has_variable = oe_tbd_job_calc }
        OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 4 current_month = 7 current_month = 10 has_variable = oe_tbd_job_calc }
    }
    effect = {
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_job_calc
        if = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_frontier = yes } oe_tbd_theme_calc = yes }
        else = { oe_tbd_clear_pressure = yes }
    }
}
